vc_checking.summary: All seven current manual witnesses are semantically proofable. The repaired loop invariant now preserves linklist_pre<>0. Initialization opens xizi_dll with done=nil and todo=nodes. Both loop-transition witnesses advance one concrete DLL node while maintaining nodes=done++todo and the exact counter/list-length relation; the unsigned increment cannot wrap because the owned aligned pointer cells imply the required prefix-length bound below 2^32. The two exit witnesses force todo=nil and rebuild the unchanged DLL while deriving the exact result length. The nil-case callable specialization follows from the general contract by choosing nodes_general=nil and an identity magic wand, and the wrapper return reduces to retval=0 plus preserved empty-DLL ownership. No public UINT_MAX/non-null premise, annotation repair, or case_lib helper is required.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Reuse the verified standalone-len shape: initialize done=nil/todo=nodes by opening xizi_dll; define local dllseg unfold, link-fold, snoc, equal-boundary stop, link-distinctness, and aligned-store facts; advance the cut by one node in each transition; derive Zlength(prefix)+2<2^32 from store_ptr_align4, store_align4_merge, and store_align4_n_valid before rewriting unsigned_last_nbits_eq; on exit force todo=nil, derive counter=Zlength nodes, rejoin the segment, and close xizi_dll. The repaired invariant directly supplies linklist_pre<>0. Keep these facts local to witness bodies and add no case_lib helper. Do not use the forbidden lemmas derivable1_refl or logic_equiv_sepcon_comm; perform framing/reordering with structured cancel, entailer, and direct predicate folds.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The counter is the length of the visited prefix, and each iteration moves exactly one owned DLL node from todo to done. Exact unsigned arithmetic is justified internally by the finite aligned address-space capacity represented by the owned pointer cells, not by a public UINT_MAX precondition.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: Same loop invariant, dllseg unfold/snoc/stop helper family, counter-bound argument, and exit reconstruction; five witnesses remain below max_witnesses_per_group=12.
